title: CTAM per-module requirement evaluation
description: The 'data' payload of GET /requirements and POST /requirements/check. Every declared selector appears, satisfied or not, so a missing optional file can never masquerade as a ready one.

satisfied.description: True when every entry with required=true is satisfied. Unsatisfied optional entries do not change this.

requirements.description: One entry per [[requires]] block in the caller's manifest, in manifest order.

selector.description: Verbatim from the manifest. Drawn from the documented selector registry; an unknown selector fails manifest validation at discovery rather than appearing here as unsatisfied.

reason.description: Null when satisfied. Otherwise names the failing condition, such as an age or history-count shortfall.

file_ids.description: Catalog entries this selector resolved to. Empty when nothing matched.

unmet_condition.description: Which declared constraint failed, when the artifact exists but does not qualify.

observed.description: The measured value for the failing condition, such as the actual age in seconds or the actual history length. Unit is implied by unmet_condition.

threshold.description: The declared value the observation was compared against.
